title: testwitness run history
description: What each test did in the last runs of one workflow, written by testwitness check --history-out and uploaded by the GitHub Action as the testwitness-history artifact. It holds normalised test keys and outcomes only: no source code, no file paths, no pull request text, no names of people. schemaVersion changes only when a field is removed or changes type.

window.description: Most runs the document keeps. testwitness writes 20. When a run is added beyond it, the oldest run rolls off.

truncated.description: Present when the 5 MB size cap could not be met by rolling off runs and some test keys of the newest run were dropped.

runs.description: The runs in the window, oldest first. Each test entry has one outcome character per run, in this order.

id.description: Workflow run id in the Action (with .<attempt> after a re-run), the --run-id value, or local-<head sha> in the CLI. A run with an id already present replaces that run.

total.description: Test keys with a record in the run.

passed.description: Keys that passed, including flaky ones.

flaky.description: Keys that failed and then passed on a rerun.

tests.description: Per normalised test key (classKey::nameKey, as the JUnit reader builds it), one character per run aligned with runs: P passed, K flaky (passed on a rerun), S skipped, F failed, f failed after reruns, E error, e error after reruns, - no record in that run. A key with no record in any run of the window is removed.
